features.name: mean_paragraphs_per_counter_comment
features.definition: What is the average number of paragraphs per counter-argument comment?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments with json.loads. For each comment string, count paragraphs: split on regex r'\n\s*\n', strip each piece, count nonempty pieces. Return the mean across comments. Empty list -> null; missing/malformed JSON -> null. Raw text count, not semantically filtered; may include outcome announcements or quotations.

h0: mean_paragraphs_per_counter_comment has no association with delta.
h1: Higher mean_paragraphs_per_counter_comment is associated with higher likelihood of delta.
note: Persuasiveness is operationalized as the dataset outcome delta (OP view change). "Counter-arguments with more paragraphs" is operationalized as the row-level mean paragraph count per comment; blank-line separation is assumed to mark paragraphs. Comments are unordered, with no per-comment outcomes, so this is a row-level association, not a per-comment effect. Comment length is not controlled. Text may contain outcome announcements (not filtered).
